plan: OpenVibe.Exchange: trade what people make — free and swap listings with a permission passport, conformance tests for each version, a sandbox, install with the passport snapshot and one-tap revoke
summary: OpenVibe.Exchange is the OpenVibe marketplace for what people make: agents, MCP tools, templates, design themes and kits, game assets and creator services. v1 is free and swap only — there is no price, no Billing and no money — and every listing carries a permission passport (reads, writes, spends, contacts) taken from its public manifest. Submitting a listing runs four conformance tests for its version and a draft is only publishable when they pass. A sandbox trial is a manifest/passport dry run (v1 does not execute a listing's code); a passed trial is consumed by the install, which keeps the exact passport snapshot. A revoke is one tap and idempotent. A free listing takes claims and a swap listing takes offers with what the other person gives; accepting closes it as given or swapped. Every public listing is one Search Fabric document queued in the service's outbox, with a tombstone on close or hide.
works: Listings with a unique slug, kind, free/swap mode, SPDX licence and URL, semantic version, manifest and permission passport; no price or money column
A passport with reads, writes, spends and contacts; spends must be empty (a table check, the form and the API agree)
Four conformance tests per version (manifest, passport, licence, no_money) stored in exchange_listing_tests; only the owner can publish and only when all pass
Sandbox trials as a manifest/passport dry run with four recorded checks, a TTL and a daily cap; a passed trial is consumed by install
Installs with the exact passport snapshot, one active per (listing, person), and one-tap idempotent revoke
Free claims and swap offers with a required give on swaps; the owner accepts/declines, the sender withdraws; accepting closes the listing and tombstones it
A fixed prohibited-items and no-money filter on every listing and offer
The API: public cursor-paged listings, detail, passport, tests, owner drafts, sandbox, install, installs, offers and staff hide
Search Fabric documents (owner exchange, type listing, /listings/<slug>) in exchange_outbox, with a tombstone when closed or hidden
Sign-in with OpenVibe.Network (PKCE S256, exchange_at/exchange_rt/exchange_oauth), staff role global_mod+
Account export and deletion over listings, installs, sandbox trials and offers; a deleted listing is anonymised, closed and tombstoned
Server-rendered pages with stable ex- ids/classes, cache headers, discovery artifacts, deploy files and the first-proof seed
notYet: The Network grant write/revoke: v1 keeps the install as an Exchange record; network.grants.write and network.grants.revoke are proposed and not in contracts v0.229.0
A real sandbox: v1 is a manifest/passport dry run; executing a listing needs OpenVibe.Run and a run.sandbox.execute capability
The Search document relay: documents wait in exchange_outbox until Network grants exchange search.document.write
Paid listings through Billing (v2): no intent, transfer, cashout, entitlement or usage call exists in v1
Reviews and mutual reviews; the listing page shows no reviews yet
A user report form and moderation queue beyond the fixed filter and staff hide
Open data/API listings, Rates and price comparisons (Zone/Services/Tools)
Skill swaps on a time bank, city free-stuff hubs, a community white-label exchange, and Inventory gifting
Developer-app/agent routes: an app token is recognised but no v1 route needs one
deployment: not deployed: the unit and nginx vhost are deploy/systemd/openvibe-exchange.service and deploy/nginx/openvibe.exchange.conf
